from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


# ============================================================================
# SYNTAX VALIDATION - Valid Formats
# ============================================================================

class TestValidSyntax:
    """Tests for valid ISO 8601 duration syntax."""

    def test_single_year(self):
        """P with single year component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 15)

    def test_single_month(self):
        """P with single month component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 4, 15)

    def test_single_week(self):
        """P with single week component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 22)

    def test_single_day(self):
        """P with single day component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16)

    def test_single_hour(self):
        """PT with single hour component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10), "PT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 11)

    def test_single_minute(self):
        """PT with single minute component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 31)

    def test_single_second(self):
        """PT with single second component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 46)

    def test_multiple_date_components(self):
        """P with multiple date components in correct order."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P1Y2M3D")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 18)

    def test_multiple_time_components(self):
        """PT with multiple time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45), "PT1H2M3S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 11, 32, 48)

    def test_date_and_time_components(self):
        """P with both date and time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15, 10, 30), "P1Y2M3DT1H2M3S")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 18, 11, 32, 3)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros in components are allowed."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P01Y02M03D")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 5, 18)

    def test_plus_sign(self):
        """Optional + sign at start."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "+P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16)

    def test_fractional_seconds_dot(self):
        """Fractional seconds with . decimal separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT1.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_comma(self):
        """Fractional seconds with , decimal separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT1,5S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 1, 500000)

    def test_fractional_minutes(self):
        """Fractional minutes (last time component)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10), "PT1.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 1, 30)

    def test_fractional_hours(self):
        """Fractional hours (last time component)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT1.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 1, 30)

    def test_fractional_days(self):
        """Fractional days (last date component before T)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 12)

    def test_fractional_weeks(self):
        """Fractional weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 29, 12)

    def test_zero_values(self):
        """Zero values in components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P0Y0M0D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15)

    def test_large_values(self):
        """Large numeric values."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P100Y")
        assert result == datetime(2120, 3, 15)

class TestInvalidSyntax:
    """Tests for invalid ISO 8601 duration syntax."""

    def test_missing_p(self):
        """Missing required P."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "1D")

    def test_p_alone(self):
        """P without any components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P")

    def test_pt_without_time(self):
        """PT without time components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT")

    def test_p_ending_with_t(self):
        """P ending with T and no time components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1DT")

    def test_weeks_with_days(self):
        """Weeks combined with days."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1W2D")

    def test_weeks_with_hours(self):
        """Weeks combined with hours."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1WT1H")

    def test_weeks_with_months(self):
        """Weeks combined with months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1M1W")

    def test_fractional_years(self):
        """Fractions not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1.5Y")

    def test_fractional_months(self):
        """Fractions not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1.5M")

    def test_fractional_non_last_component(self):
        """Fractions only on last component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1.5D2D")

    def test_fractional_hours_with_minutes(self):
        """Fractions only on last component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT1.5H2M")

    def test_sign_on_component(self):
        """Sign on individual component (not at start)."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P-1D")

    def test_whitespace(self):
        """No whitespace allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P 1D")

    def test_lowercase_p(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "p1D")

    def test_lowercase_designators(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1d")

    def test_duplicate_year(self):
        """Component appears more than once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1Y2Y")

    def test_duplicate_month(self):
        """Component appears more than once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1M2M")

    def test_duplicate_day(self):
        """Component appears more than once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1D2D")

    def test_duplicate_hour(self):
        """Component appears more than once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT1H2H")

    def test_components_out_of_order(self):
        """Components must appear in correct order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1D1M")

    def test_components_out_of_order_time(self):
        """Components must appear in correct order."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT1M1H")

    def test_fractional_missing_integer_part(self):
        """Fractional must have digits on each side."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT.5S")

    def test_fractional_missing_decimal_part(self):
        """Fractional must have digits on each side."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT1.S")

    def test_multiple_decimal_separators(self):
        """Only one decimal point allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT1.5.5S")

    def test_empty_string(self):
        """Empty duration string."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "")

    def test_negative_sign_in_middle(self):
        """Negative sign must be at start."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1D-2D")

    def test_no_digits_in_component(self):
        """Component must have at least one digit."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PD")

    def test_invalid_character(self):
        """Invalid characters in duration."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1X")

class TestPositiveDateDurations:
    """Tests for adding positive date durations."""

    def test_add_years(self):
        """Add years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P5Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_add_months(self):
        """Add months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P7M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 10, 15)

    def test_add_months_wrapping_year(self):
        """Add months that wrap to next year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P10M")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 1, 15)

    def test_add_years_and_months_together(self):
        """Years and months applied together (12*years + months)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 2, 15)

    def test_add_years_and_months_total_months(self):
        """Years and months: 1 year 11 months = 23 months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P1Y11M")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 12, 15)

    def test_add_weeks(self):
        """Add weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 29)

    def test_add_days(self):
        """Add days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 25)

    def test_add_days_wrapping_month(self):
        """Add days wrapping to next month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 25), "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 4, 4)

    def test_add_weeks_and_days_together(self):
        """Weeks and days are added as 7-day and 1-day multiples."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P2W3D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 31)

    def test_month_overflow_february_leap_year(self):
        """Day doesn't exist in target month: Jan 31 + 1M = Feb 29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_month_overflow_february_non_leap_year(self):
        """Day doesn't exist in target month: Jan 31 + 1M = Feb 28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2023, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 2, 28)

    def test_month_overflow_april(self):
        """Day doesn't exist in target month: Mar 31 + 1M = Apr 30."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 4, 30)

    def test_month_overflow_multiple_months(self):
        """Month overflow with multiple month jumps: Jan 31 + 3M = Apr 30."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 31), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 4, 30)

    def test_month_overflow_with_years(self):
        """Month overflow combined with years: 2024-01-31 + P1Y1M = 2025-02-28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_all_date_components(self):
        """P with years, months, and days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15), "P2Y3M4D")
        assert result == datetime(2022, 4, 19)

    def test_date_component_time_preserved(self):
        """Date components preserve time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15, 14, 30, 45, 123456), "P1Y2M3D")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 18, 14, 30, 45, 123456)

class TestPositiveTimeDurations:
    """Tests for adding positive time durations."""

    def test_add_hours(self):
        """Add hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10), "PT5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 15)

    def test_add_hours_wrapping_day(self):
        """Add hours wrapping to next day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 22), "PT5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 3)

    def test_add_minutes(self):
        """Add minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT45M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 11, 15)

    def test_add_minutes_wrapping_hour(self):
        """Add minutes wrapping to next hour."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 45), "PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 11, 15)

    def test_add_seconds(self):
        """Add seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 30), "PT45S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 31, 15)

    def test_add_seconds_wrapping_minute(self):
        """Add seconds wrapping to next minute."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45), "PT30S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 31, 15)

    def test_add_all_time_components(self):
        """PT with hours, minutes, and seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45), "PT2H15M30S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 12, 46, 15)

    def test_add_time_wrapping_days(self):
        """Time components wrapping multiple days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 23, 30), "PT3H45M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 16, 3, 15)

class TestPositiveMixedDurations:
    """Tests for adding durations with mixed components and fractions."""

    def test_date_and_time_simple(self):
        """Add both date and time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15, 10, 30), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 18, 14, 35, 6)

    def test_fractional_seconds_to_microseconds(self):
        """Fractional seconds convert to microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT0.1S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 0, 100000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_full_precision(self):
        """Fractional seconds with full microsecond precision."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT0.123456S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 0, 123456)

    def test_fractional_minutes_to_seconds(self):
        """0.5 minutes = 30 seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30), "PT0.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 30)

    def test_fractional_hours_to_minutes(self):
        """0.5 hours = 30 minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10), "PT0.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30)

    def test_fractional_days_to_hours(self):
        """0.5 days = 12 hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 12)

    def test_fractional_weeks_to_days(self):
        """0.5 weeks = 3.5 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 18, 12)

    def test_fractional_weeks_multiple(self):
        """1.5 weeks = 10.5 days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "P1.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 25, 12)

    def test_complex_fractional(self):
        """Complex duration with fractional component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 15, 12), "P1Y2M3D4H5M6.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 3, 18, 16, 5, 6, 500000)

    def test_fractional_rounding_to_microseconds(self):
        """Very fine fractions round to nearest microsecond."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT0.0000001S")
        # Should round to nearest microsecond
        assert result.microsecond == 0

    def test_fractional_rounding_half_even(self):
        """Test rounding behavior for fractions."""
        # 0.5000005 seconds = 500000.5 microseconds -> rounds to 500001
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT0.5000005S")
        assert result.microsecond == 500001

class TestNegativeDurations:
    """Tests for subtracting durations (negative sign)."""

    def test_negative_single_day(self):
        """Subtract a single day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 14)

    def test_negative_multiple_days(self):
        """Subtract multiple days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 5)

    def test_negative_days_wrapping_month(self):
        """Subtract days wrapping to previous month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 5), "-P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 24)

    def test_negative_months(self):
        """Subtract months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 1, 15)

    def test_negative_years(self):
        """Subtract years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P5Y")
        assert result == datetime(2015, 3, 15)

    def test_negative_months_wrapping_year(self):
        """Subtract months wrapping to previous year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "-P5M")
        assert result == datetime(2019, 10, 15)

    def test_negative_month_overflow_february(self):
        """Month overflow on negative: Mar 31 - 1M = Feb 29 (leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_negative_month_overflow_february_non_leap(self):
        """Month overflow on negative: Mar 31 - 1M = Feb 28 (non-leap)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2023, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 2, 28)

    def test_negative_years_and_months(self):
        """Subtract years and months together."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2021, 3, 18), "-P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 2, 18)

    def test_negative_years_and_months_multiple_months(self):
        """2024-03-31 - P1Y1M: first back 13 months = 2023-02-28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2023, 2, 28)

    def test_negative_months_then_days(self):
        """2024-03-01 - P1M1D: first back 1 month = 2024-02-01, then back 1 day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_negative_hours(self):
        """Subtract hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 15), "-PT5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10)

    def test_negative_minutes(self):
        """Subtract minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 45), "-PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 15)

    def test_negative_seconds(self):
        """Subtract seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45), "-PT30S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 15)

    def test_negative_time_wrapping_days(self):
        """Subtract time wrapping to previous day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 2, 30), "-PT5H")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 14, 21, 30)

    def test_negative_fractional(self):
        """Subtract fractional duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 12), "-P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 0)

    def test_negative_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Subtract fractional seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 1), "-PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 0, 500000)

    def test_negative_mixed(self):
        """Subtract mixed date and time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2021, 3, 18, 14, 35, 6), "-P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0)

class TestDatetimeBoundaries:
    """Tests for datetime boundaries and edge cases."""

    def test_min_datetime_boundary(self):
        """Adding before datetime.min raises ValueError."""
        min_dt = datetime.min
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(min_dt, "-P1D")

    def test_max_datetime_boundary(self):
        """Adding after datetime.max raises ValueError."""
        max_dt = datetime.max
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(max_dt, "P1D")

    def test_very_large_year_addition(self):
        """Add very large number of years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(1, 1, 1), "P9999Y")
        # datetime.max is year 9999, so this should work
        assert result.year == 9999

    def test_datetime_at_year_boundary(self):
        """Adding across year boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 12, 31), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2021, 1, 1)

    def test_datetime_subtracting_across_year_boundary(self):
        """Subtracting across year boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2021, 1, 1), "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2020, 12, 31)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_add_day(self):
        """Add day from Feb 29 in leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_add_year(self):
        """Add year from Feb 29 in leap year (to non-leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_add_four_years(self):
        """Add 4 years from Feb 29 (to another leap year)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P4Y")
        assert result == datetime(2028, 2, 29)

    def test_zero_duration(self):
        """Adding zero duration returns same datetime."""
        dt = datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45, 123456)
        result = add_duration(dt, "P0Y")
        assert result == dt

    def test_zero_all_components(self):
        """Zero all components."""
        dt = datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45)
        result = add_duration(dt, "P0Y0M0W0DT0H0M0S")
        assert result == dt

class TestPrecisionAndRounding:
    """Tests for microsecond precision and rounding."""

    def test_microsecond_precision_preserved(self):
        """Microseconds in input datetime are preserved."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15, 10, 30, 45, 123456), "P0Y")
        assert result.microsecond == 123456

    def test_microsecond_precision_in_fractions(self):
        """Fractional seconds result in correct microseconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT0.000001S")
        assert result.microsecond == 1

    def test_microsecond_precision_in_fractions_max(self):
        """Fractional seconds with maximum microsecond value."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 3, 15), "PT0.999999S")
        assert result.microsecond == 999999

    def test_rounding_to_nearest_microsecond(self):
        """Fractions are rounded to nearest microsecond."""
        # 0.5000005 seconds = 500000.5 microseconds

        min_dt = datetime.min
        result = add_duration(min_dt, "P1D")
        assert result == datetime.min + timedelta(days=1)
    
    def test_max_datetime(self):
        """Operations on maximum datetime."""
        max_dt = datetime.max
        result = add_duration(max_dt, "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime.max - timedelta(days=1)
    
    def test_overflow_exceeds_max(self):
        """Overflow beyond maximum datetime raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime.max, "P1D")
    
    def test_underflow_below_min(self):
        """Underflow below minimum datetime raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime.min, "-P1D")
    
    def test_large_year_addition(self):
        """Large year additions should work within bounds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(5000, 1, 1), "P4999Y")
        assert result.year == 9999
    
    def test_year_overflow_at_boundary(self):
        """Adding years that would overflow raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(9999, 1, 1), "P1Y")
    
    def test_month_to_year_overflow(self):
        """Months that roll over to next year near boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(9998, 12, 1), "P13M")
        assert result == datetime(9999, 12, 31) or result.year == 9999

class TestTimePreservation:

        result = add_duration(dt, "P2M")
        assert result.hour == 14
        assert result.minute == 30
        assert result.second == 45

    def test_years_preserve_time(self):
        """Adding years should preserve time components."""
        dt = datetime(2025, 6, 20, 9, 15, 30, 999999)
        result = add_duration(dt, "P3Y")
        assert result.hour == 9
        assert result.minute == 15
        assert result.second == 30

        result = add_duration(dt, "P5D")
        assert result.microsecond == 500000
